enchant_guidance.label: Should Feral DPS Choose Aldor or Scryer for BiS in TBC Classic Phase 1?
enchant_guidance.text: Unlike most other specs in TBC, the choice of Aldor versus Scryer faction has almost zero impact on the long-term PvE performance of a Feral Druid. For Feral DPS, the only permanently relevant items provided by these factions are the two shoulder enchants:  and , which require Exalted reputation with the Aldor and Scryer factions, respectively. Despite providing different distributions of Attack Power versus Critical Strike Rating, simulations show that both enchants provide identical DPS value to within the simulation resolution of +/- 1 DPS. So feel free to choose either faction based on personal preference, as the choice will not impact your DPS output whatsoever in the long run.
